$comment: Riftlight authored opening draft. Development preview only; see ../README.md. Production campaign id will be riftlight. No bonus XP: preserve the design bible campaign budget.
title: A Map with a Missing Pass

plate.narration: Outside the singing hall, packs rest beside a waiting sled. Beyond its sheltered ledge, white paths disappear between the peaks. There is room on the map for more than one road.

goal.text: Meet the travelers and get ready for the road ahead.

map.narration: The griffin calls to the unicorn. "Olivia. Your hoof." She steps aside. Another corner is stuck under a bag, so he gives up on the map. "Good morning. I'm Orin Vale." "I'm Lady Olivia," says the unicorn. Behind them, a kitsune straps up a case of small rings. "Seren Wisp," she says, waving. Beside Orin's pack sits a case of little brass instruments. Your job today: meet these travelers, help them pack, and get ready for the road ahead.

arrival_story.narration: You tell Orin about the snow, the kid, and the quay vanishing behind you. He writes down "goat" and underlines it. Olivia leans over his shoulder. "And it reached all the way here."

arrival_question.narration: "We saw it close," says Seren. "You all came through together? Good." Orin opens his notebook. Olivia watches the slope where the fold closed.

fellowship.narration: "Riftseekers," says Orin, touching the broken-circle clasp on his cloak. "We call these openings rifts. We follow them and write down what they do." "Some of us want to do more than write," says Lady Olivia. The travelers' sled leans like a sleepy goat. "We leave when it stops leaning," says Orin.

sledge_lift.narration: Four trunks, three sacks, a crate of notebooks and a barrel that sloshes. "Heavy things low," says Olivia. "Hand to hand," says Orin.

interaction.cue: Catch each trunk and pass it along to the sled.

onSuccess.narration: Up it all goes. The sled sits level as a loaf. Olivia hands you a small clay jar. "Mosslight, for the road. You earned it."

onFailure.narration: The barrel and the trunks meet in the middle, and a sack of oats bursts. The sled keeps its lean.

onAssisted.narration: Orin steadies the line with a pole. The sled sits level. Olivia hands you a small clay jar. "Mosslight, for the road."

sledge_brace.narration: Brace is a stout sort of magic: plant your feet and become a wall.
sledge_brace.prompt: Hold the sled steady while the heavy trunks go on.

onSuccess.narration: Not one runner wobbles. Olivia hands you a small clay jar. "Mosslight, for the road. You earned it."

onFailure.narration: The barrel and the trunks meet in the middle, and a sack of oats bursts. The sled keeps its lean.

sledge_smash.narration: Old ice grips the runners like a hand. Smash is a good answer to that.
sledge_smash.prompt: Smash the ice off the runners, then shove the sled level.

onSuccess.narration: Crack! Ice flies off like glitter, and the sled rocks upright. Olivia hands you a small clay jar. "Mosslight, for the road."

onFailure.narration: The barrel and the trunks meet in the middle, and a sack of oats bursts. The sled keeps its lean.

ring_sort.narration: Seren opens her ring case. Rings of every size lie inside, each with a tiny hum, all jumbled. "They go back in order, or they'll sing in my pack all night." She hands out cards. "Each card knows something. Share what yours says."

interaction.cue: Share your clues, then put the rings in order.
clues: The low ring goes in first.
The high ring goes right before the middle ring.

onSuccess.narration: Click, click, click. "Hm," says Seren. "You are better at this than Orin."

onFailure.narration: Two rings land in the wrong grooves. "I'll fix it by the fire," says Seren. "Rings are patient."

onAssisted.narration: You lay the cards side by side. Low, high, middle. Click.

seren.narration: Seren asks where the opening appeared and how long it lasted. She listens without interrupting. Orin rolls his map around a rod so nobody can stand on it again.

variants.text: When you tell her about the light around the opening, Seren turns to the hero who saw it. "You saw the light. Keep looking. Later I can show you how to listen, too."
"You can learn a lot without seeing what I see," says Seren.

instruments.narration: Orin opens his case of little brass instruments. Frost has crept into every hinge, and a tiny trumpet won't move at all. A drop of warm tea, a twist, and it sings true. "Better than new," Orin tells Seren. Seren says that is not possible, and smiles.

corner_hunt.narration: Orin unrolls his map and groans. One corner is torn off. "It's still under the load!" Trunks are heavy, and paper is not. Slip, slide, free. Orin hugs the corner, then remembers himself and only pats it.

lead.narration: Orin spreads the mended map and points east. "The griffins at Frostfang keep a record of their passes. Last season, no pass here. This season, cairns and a path. They call it the Cairnstep." He marks the herder's flooded grazing route beside it. "If the pass reaches this bank, food could reach the herd. It might also show us why roads no longer go where people expect."

olivia.narration: Olivia taps the flooded route. "I have food in my pack. Carry it through an opening, and the herd eats today." "I will carry food," says Orin. "But I will not send anyone into a rift before we know they can come back." Seren watches your faces. "What comes first?"

help_now.narration: Olivia takes a supper bundle from her pack and calls the herder over. "This much can go by hand." Orin makes room for it on the sled. "And we learn the route before we send more." Seren nods. "A good place to begin."

safe_routes.narration: Orin draws a careful line beside the Cairnstep. "A route people can trust. Yes." Olivia leaves a supper bundle for the herder anyway. Seren looks at the glacier. "And if the road is not your question, listen here."

haul_supper.narration: The herder's tent stands across a yard of slick ice.
haul_supper.prompt: Steer the sled around the slick patches to the herder's tent.

onSuccess.narration: The sled glides like a duck on a pond. "Warm," sighs the herder. Orin pays you four coins from a flat tin, the Riftseekers' helper fund. The herder adds a honeycake.

onFailure.narration: The sled spins once on glare ice, slowly, with great dignity. Orin counts two coins from a flat tin, the Riftseekers' helper fund. "For effort."

chalk_route.narration: Orin hands you a stick of chalk. "Mark the bank where my goats walk," says the herder, "and mark it right."
chalk_route.prompt: Walk the bank beside the hall and chalk every steady stone.

onSuccess.narration: Your chalk line runs straight, steady stone to steady stone. Orin pays you four coins from a flat tin, the Riftseekers' helper fund. The herder adds a warm honeycake.

onFailure.narration: You chalk a wobbly stone, and a goat proves it by sitting on it. Orin counts two coins from a flat tin, the Riftseekers' helper fund. "For honesty."

route.narration: Orin points below the ice shelf, where melt channels join into a broad river. "The Great River starts here. Stay on this bank. The shelf above the headwaters leads toward Frostfang. Test the ice. If it gives, let the river carry you to a place you can get out. Do not fight it under the shelf." Seren points toward the hall. "Or study the seam that answered your song. Look for signs of openings around the glacier. Learning what they need might help you find a way home." Orin traces a longer road above the bank. "Or follow these markers to a ferry at a place called Ashspan Bridge. It takes longer, but it stays off the ice. From the bridge, an upper bank road goes back north to Frostfang Shore."

lookout.narration: From the ledge by the hall, melt channels braid down toward the Great River. Above them, the ice shelf shines. Orin hands you his spyglass, then takes it back to find the right end. "Look first," he says. "Then walk."

lookout_climb.narration: The rock stair is more of a rumor than a stair, glued together with frost.
lookout_climb.prompt: Climb to the high ledge without losing a boot.

onSuccess.narration: The river lies below like a silver ribbon. One dark patch on the shelf looks thin. You remember where.

onFailure.narration: A step turns out to be only a rumor. You slide into a soft drift, but you can still see most of the shelf.

lookout_sky.narration: The wind drags snow across the ice. Watch the snow, and you see what the ice is doing.
lookout_sky.prompt: Watch the drifting snow and clouds. Where is the air coming from?

onSuccess.narration: Snow streams off one patch of the shelf faster than anywhere else. That patch is thin.

onFailure.narration: The clouds say rain, snow, or nothing. The sky is being mysterious on purpose.

lookout_fly.narration: Wings make a lookout easy, if the wind agrees. One hero rises while the others call up what to look for.
lookout_fly.prompt: Fly a slow circle and read the ice from above.

onSuccess.narration: From above, one dark patch shows where the ice is thin.

onFailure.narration: A gust flips you sideways. You flutter down laughing, with snow in your feathers.

sketch.narration: Orin unrolls his map beside the sled and hands you his pencil. "Draw what you saw. Maps are made by whoever looked last." What do you add?

sketch_shelf.narration: You draw the shelf like a long white tongue above the river. "Wobbly and true beats neat and wrong," says Orin. Olivia lifts her nose. "Wind is coming! Hold the cover!"

variants.text: You add a small dark patch where the ice looked thin. Orin circles it twice.

sketch_bend.narration: You draw the river's first bend, where the melt channels pour in. "Loud water hides small sounds," says Seren. "Remember that." Olivia lifts her nose. "Wind is coming! Hold the cover!"

sketch_hall.narration: You draw the singing hall and the sealed seam behind it. Orin writes "ASK" beside it, very small. "That is a question worth a trip." Olivia lifts her nose. "Wind is coming! Hold the cover!"

tarp.narration: The gust slides under the sled cover and lifts it high. "Our cover thinks it is a sail!" shouts Olivia.

variants.text: The leaning sled catches the wind too.

tarp.prompt: Everyone grab a corner and tie the cover down!

onSuccess.narration: Knot, knot, knot. The cover snaps once, then lies down like a tired dog.

onFailure.narration: The cover escapes like a fat white bird. You chase it into a drift and drag it back, cold and bruised.

tea.narration: Seren builds a small stove from a tin and a candle. Steam fogs Orin's glasses. He leaves them fogged. "Hands first," says Seren. "Questions after." Whose story do you ask for?

tea_seren.narration: Seren holds her cup in both paws. "I heard a hum like a kettle, behind a barn. I followed it in my slippers." She sips. "Never follow a kettle in slippers. Bring boots. Bring somebody who will pull you back."

tea_olivia.narration: Olivia swirls her tea. "A door that opens by itself? I want to know whose hand is on it, and whether I could borrow it for the herd." Orin coughs. "Ask. Do not borrow." "I always ask," says Olivia. "Loudly."

supplies.narration: Seren opens a battered tin of spares: cord, a very small spoon, and a brass whistle on a loop. "A brave whistle costs three coins." Behind the sled, the herder's goats are chewing the tow rope again. What do you do with your last minutes here?

supplies_buy.narration: Three coins clink into Seren's tin. She hands over the whistle. "One loud note. Use it when you need to be heard, not when you want to be."

supplies_feed.narration: The goats bundle around you, soft noses everywhere. The herder presses a river charm into your hand. "Found it in a melt channel. It likes people who share."

supplies_tight.narration: You check every knot twice and tug the lashings tight. The sled stops creaking. "The best spare is a good knot," says Seren.

supplies_oil.narration: You rub tallow into the runners until they shine. It smells like warm candles. The sled slides forward at one nudge, and Olivia has to catch it.

chime.narration: Orin takes a little chime from his bag. "A Listening Chime, for you. Strike it near an opening. A sour note means it cannot open yet. An echo means it will stay open and let you come back. No echo? Then promise nobody a trip home. Away from a rift, it is only a very small bell."

test_chime.narration: The Listening Chime hangs from a short cord, light enough for one hand. "How would you test it?" asks Orin.

ring.narration: You strike it. One clear note rings over the snow and fades. No opening answers. "See?" says Orin. "A very small bell." "Still worth keeping," says Seren.

wrap.narration: "Sour means not ready. Echo means a way back," you say. Orin nods and hands you a soft cloth for it. "And never ask it the name of a place. It does not know names."

chime_jar.narration: You hold the mosslight jar close. The chime throws a shivery shadow across the snow. "Now you can find it in the dark," says Seren. Orin writes: "Chime, visible by lamplight."

chime_whistle.narration: You blow the brave whistle. Every goat looks up. The chime does not answer at all. "It does not take orders from whistles," says Orin. "Good. That would be a very bossy chime."

trial_intro.narration: Seren sets three rings on a flat stone and turns her back. Olivia flaps a blanket. Orin plays a squeaky note on his horn. "A rift won't be quiet for you," says Seren. "Two rings ring true. One rings sour. Find the sour one through all this noise."

trial_read.narration: The rings sit in a row. The blanket flaps. The horn squeaks. Which ring is sour, and how will you find out?

trial_ear.narration: You shut your eyes. Under the flapping and squeaking, three rings hum.
trial_ear.prompt: Pick out the sour ring through the noise.

onSuccess.narration: You point at the middle ring. Seren's ears twitch, which means yes.

onFailure.narration: You point at the first ring. It is true, and it says so, loudly.

trial_chime.narration: Here the chime is only a bell, but a bell with a good ear. It rings sweet beside a true ring and buzzes beside a sour one.
trial_chime.prompt: Swing the chime by each ring before Olivia flaps the blanket again.

onSuccess.narration: You point at the middle ring. Seren's ears twitch, which means yes.

onFailure.narration: You point at the first ring. It is true, and it says so, loudly.

trial_hum.narration: Rally listens before it sings. You hum, and wait to hear which ring hums back crooked.
trial_hum.prompt: Hum to each ring and hear which one answers wrong.

onSuccess.narration: You point at the middle ring. Seren's ears twitch, which means yes.

onFailure.narration: You point at the first ring. It is true, and it says so, loudly.

trial_report.narration: Seren turns around. "The middle ring was sour. A rift warns you the same way: one wrong note among right ones. Hear it, and you do not walk in. Hear the echo, and a door stays open behind you." Orin writes it down, then crosses it out. "Too wordy."

trial_echo.narration: "Listen," says Seren, and the blanket goes still. She taps the three rings in a slow, clear pattern. Olivia holds her breath, which for Olivia is a lot.

interaction.cue: Watch Seren tap the rings, then tap the same rings in the same order.

onSuccess.narration: Low, high, middle, low. Seren's ears twitch twice, which means yes.

onFailure.narration: Your echo comes out jumbled. Seren taps it again, slowly, and you hear where it wandered.

onAssisted.narration: Seren taps it again while Orin hums along. This time it sticks.

trial_all.narration: Seren shuffles the rings behind her back and strikes one. Olivia flaps harder. Orin plays his squeaky note with great pride. Every finger points the same way, and the sour note proves you right. Olivia salutes with the blanket.

prep.narration: The sled is packed. Orin taps the ice shelf on his map. Seren glances back at the singing hall. "Three roads," she says. "The shelf toward the Cairnstep, with food for the herd. The glacier, looking for openings. Or the long bank road to Ashspan Bridge, off the ice." Which road do you get ready for?

prep_ice.narration: Orin lays a slab of old ice on the snow. "Thick ice rings when you tap it. Thin ice thuds." Ring, ring, thud! You find the thin spot. Orin cheers very quietly, so as not to wake the ice.

variants.text: You remember the dark patch you saw from the ledge. It will probably thud.

prep_seam.narration: Seren presses an ear to the glacier wall. "Listen for a tick. Listen for a hum." You find where the seam hums clearest and mark it with a pebble. "A hum that holds still can be learned," says Seren.

prep_jar.narration: You hold up the mosslight jar, and the glacier wall glows like a lantern. One frost line runs straight to the sealed seam and stops. "The ice remembers where the seam is," says Seren.

prep_bank.narration: Little stone markers run along the bank, each a neat heap. The wind has tipped some over. You set every one straight, and the road to the bridge looks friendlier. Orin ticks something off in his notebook.

prep_dash.narration: A duskrunner's feet know the quiet way. One hero runs the bank road and comes back breathless: no gaps, no drifts, only a goat on a rock. Orin writes down "goat on rock."

parting.narration: Olivia shoulders her pack. Seren counts the cases twice. Orin leads the way down the path, holding up the map. "If the Cairnstep has moved," he calls back, "do draw it in the right place."

variants.text: The sled still leans a little. Olivia pats it. "Character."

camp_play.narration: The Riftseekers are gone down the path. The goats wander over, and the yetis lean out of the hall door. "Nobody leaves without a send-off," says the herder.

interaction.cue: Give the goats and the hall a proper send-off.

options.label: Hum the low note
options.reaction: The hall hums back, low and warm.

options.label: Pet a goat
options.reaction: A goat leans its whole weight against your knees.

options.label: Cheer for the road
options.reaction: Every goat looks up, then goes back to chewing the tow rope.

onSuccess.narration: The low note rolls out of the hall. The herder waves, and the little goat tries to wave too.

onFailure.narration: The goats are busy with the tow rope, and the yetis with a very long note. You wave anyway.

camp.narration: You sit on a dry stone by the singing hall, the Listening Chime between you. East, the ice shelf leads to the Cairnstep, and maybe food for the herd. Behind you, the sealed seam answered your song, and the glacier may hide more openings. Or the long marked bank road goes to Ashspan Bridge, off the ice. Which matters most? Talk it over.

camp_supper.narration: You split the food on the dry stone, crumb by crumb. It tastes like a good decision. The Listening Chime swings gently, as if it is licking its lips.

camp_hall.narration: Through the hall door, a yeti hums the low note you learned. It rises to meet you, then fades. The hall will keep your note until you come back.

set_out.narration: You brush the snow off your packs and stand. Inside the hall, the yetis hold their low note a little longer, as if they are waving. The shelf, the glacier openings, or the long bank road: which comes first?

voiceGuide.tone: Warm, funny, curious, with real consequences. Describe actions and sensory details directly. Short dialogue. Never use "the kind of thing that", "the sort of thing that", or "it was X, the type of thing that makes you Y" comparisons. Let a character act instead of explaining how the reader should feel.
voiceGuide.vocabulary: Read aloud to an eight-year-old. Concrete words, short sentences, distinct voices.

npcVoices.Orin Vale: He/him, griffin Riftseeker. Methodical, patient, plain speech, asks questions instead of explaining the world. Offers one optional practical lead; no Pangea theory yet.
npcVoices.Lady Olivia: She/her, unicorn Riftseeker. Confident, mischievous, sees useful possibilities in rifts. Wants power to help, no threats and no early summoning.
npcVoices.Seren Wisp: She/her, kitsune Riftseeker. Careful, perceptive, kind. Recognizes an earlier Starweaver reading by its flag. Promises teaching later; does not grant Attune here.

listening_chime.name: Listening Chime
listening_chime.text: Near a rift: sour means not ready; an echo means it stays open and offers a way back.
